Security Policy
===============

If you found something which shouldn't be there or a bug which opens a security
hole, please report it privately via GitHub Private Vulnerability Reporting:
open the **Security** tab of the affected repository and click
**Report a vulnerability**
(`https://github.com/spiral/<repo>/security/advisories/new`).

The report is visible only to the maintainers until an advisory is published.

DO NOT PUBLISH SECURITY REPORTS PUBLICLY (e.g. in issues or pull requests).
